name: Prompt2Shorts
description: Prompt2Shorts is an innovative application that generates short-form content by transforming prompts into full scripts, voice-over audio, and relevant videos. Designed for creators who want to quickly produce engaging content, Prompt2Shorts integrates advanced AI and APIs to automate the creation process.

paragraphs: Prompt2Shorts is an innovative application that generates short-form content by transforming prompts into full scripts, voice-over audio, and relevant videos. Designed for creators who want to quickly produce engaging content, Prompt2Shorts integrates advanced AI and APIs to automate the creation process.
features: Script Generation: Utilizes Nous: Hermes 3 AI to convert prompts into well-structured scripts.
Voice Over Audio: Generates high-quality voice-over audio using Express Voic AI.
Video Retrieval: Fetches relevant video clips from Pexels API based on the generated script.
Video Editing: Provides an editing interface for users to customize and compile their final video with transitions and captions.
